name: MiniMaxSparseAttentionPrefill

q.description: Main query [T, 64, 128], bfloat16, contiguous, no NaN/Inf. T is the chunked-prefill query token count (4096 or 8192); the chunk corresponds to the last T positions of the KV sequence.

index_q.description: Index query [T, 4, 128], bfloat16; one index head per GQA group, used only for block selection scores.

k.description: Main key [L, 4, 128], bfloat16, contiguous, no NaN/Inf. L is the full KV sequence length with L >= T.

v.description: Main value [L, 4, 128], bfloat16, contiguous, no NaN/Inf.

index_k.description: Single shared index key [L, 128], bfloat16; shared by all 4 GQA groups for block selection scores.

out.description: Per-head context before the W_o projection [T, 64, 128], bfloat16.

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


@torch.no_grad()
def run(
    q: torch.Tensor,
    index_q: torch.Tensor,
    k: torch.Tensor,
    v: torch.Tensor,
    index_k: torch.Tensor,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    T = q.shape[0]
    history_len = k.shape[0] - T
    block_size = 128
    topk_blocks = 16
    group_size = 16
    scale = 128 ** -0.5

    q_fp32 = q.float()
    index_q_fp32 = index_q.float()
    index_k_fp32 = index_k.float()
    output = torch.empty((T, 64, 128), device=q.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    block_offsets = torch.arange(block_size, device=q.device)

    for p in range(T):
        visible_len = history_len + p + 1
        num_blocks = (visible_len + block_size - 1) // block_size

        token_scores = (
            index_q_fp32[p] @ index_k_fp32[:visible_len].T
        ) * scale

        padded_len = num_blocks * block_size
        token_scores = F.pad(
            token_scores,
            (0, padded_len - visible_len),
            value=-torch.inf,
        )
        block_scores = token_scores.view(
            4, num_blocks, block_size
        ).amax(dim=-1)

        local_block = (visible_len - 1) // block_size
        block_scores[:, local_block] = torch.inf

        keep = min(topk_blocks, num_blocks)
        selected_blocks = torch.argsort(
            block_scores,
            dim=-1,
            descending=True,
            stable=True,
        )[:, :keep]
        selected_blocks = selected_blocks.sort(dim=-1).values

        for group in range(4):
            token_ids = (
                selected_blocks[group, :, None] * block_size
                + block_offsets[None, :]
            ).reshape(-1)
            token_ids = token_ids[token_ids < visible_len]

            h0 = group * group_size
            h1 = h0 + group_size
            selected_k = k[token_ids, group].float()
            selected_v = v[token_ids, group].float()

            logits = (
                q_fp32[p, h0:h1] @ selected_k.T
            ) * scale
            probabilities = torch.softmax(
                logits, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32
            )
            output[p, h0:h1] = probabilities @ selected_v

    return output.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
description: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) forward for chunked prefill (MiniMax-M3). Index branch scores every causal-visible key block (block_size=128) per query token and per GQA group with dot(index_q, index_k) * 1/sqrt(128), keeps the query's local block plus the top-15 scoring blocks (topk_blocks=16, ties broken by ascending block id). Main branch computes FP32 scaled dot-product attention (64 query heads, 4 KV heads, group size 16) over the selected, causal-unmasked tokens with a single softmax over all selected tokens. Index scores only select blocks and never enter the attention weights. All inputs are projected, QK-normed and RoPE'd beforehand; KV-cache management, quantization and W_o are out of scope.
